title: Staggered Immersion Pathways: 14→60 Day Pulse & Interview Evidence Rubric
summary: A lightweight, experiment-stage onboarding approach that staggers technical immersion across two overlapping pathways (role-first and platform-first) with a 14->60 day pulse cadence and an embedded interview-evidence rubric to surface early signals for hiring calibration and mentor pairing.
body:
Context and intent:

We're piloting a staggered immersion model to reduce early overwhelm and speed practical contribution for new engineering hires who will interact with inference-serving and platform stacks. The idea: rather than one monolithic 30-day ramp, provide two overlapping pathways that let new hires toggle between role-specific micro-sprints and platform-level checkpoints. This doc is a working playbook for a 14-day activation pulse repeated/expanded to 60 days and a short interview-evidence rubric to capture signal during hiring and early onboarding.

Objectives:
- Preserve psychological safety and reduce cognitive load in week 1–2.
- Produce measurable early outputs (ticket fixes, infra runbook edits, test coverage) by day 14.
- Capture structured evidence from hiring interviews so mentor handoffs are tightly scoped.
- Improve mentor matching by aligning skill transfer needs with mentor strengths.
- Run 8-person pilot and evaluate retention, time-to-first-PR, and confidence scores.

Audience:
- Hiring managers, interviewers, people-ops program leads, mentors, recruiting partners.

Core design (high level):
1) Two pathways (run in parallel, explicit split of focus):
   - Role-first pathway (R): day-to-day product/feature work, small scoped tickets, domain context (product API, customers).
   - Platform-first pathway (P): infra, observability, deployment, security basics required for the role.
2) Pulse cadence (14→60):
   - Day 0: welcome + access + buddy intro + quick runbook sprint (30–60m).
   - Day 1–7: R-focused micro-sprints (1 PR each), P light touch (guided lab).
   - Day 8–14: mirror: P deeper lab (deploy pipeline touch), R maintains feature progress. End-of-pulse check-in + evidence capture.
   - Weeks 3–8: repeat pulses with increasing autonomy; re-scope tasks to broaden surface area.

Practical schedule (sample for engineering IC):
- Day 0: orientation checklist (OKRs for 14-day pulse), repo access, local dev setup, mentor/peer calendar blocks, 1:1 with manager (30m).
- Day 1–3: small bug + unit test -> merge; walkthrough of model-serving repo (45m).
- Day 4–7: infra lab: run a canary locally, examine tracing for one request (mentor pair).
- Day 8: mid-pulse retro (15m) + evidence capture in hiring DB.
- Day 9–14: shipping a small feature or infra PR; end-of-pulse demo to team (15m).

Mentor cadence and responsibilities:
- Primary mentor (technical) — 2 hours/week scheduled pair sessions during pulse; async review within 24h for PRs flagged as "onboarding".
- Peer buddy (eq level +1) — focus on cultural and navigation questions; 3 quick async check-ins in pulse.
- Hiring manager — weekly 1:1, explicit success criteria for pulse.
- Mentor rotation: after pulse 2, consider rotating to broaden context if candidate will cross-domains.

Interview evidence rubric (short, to be captured in recruiting notes + kept in onboarding handoff):
- Signal buckets (pick 1–2 observable behaviors per interview):
   * System design sensibility (can decompose a serving latency problem; trades explained) — observed: strong/ok/weak
   * Debugging throughput (time to isolate root cause in whiteboard exercise) — observed: strong/ok/weak
   * Communicates constraints (cost/latency/security tradeoffs) — observed: strong/ok/weak
   * PR hygiene and review skill (reads diff, suggests improvements) — observed: strong/ok/weak
   * Mentor learnability signal (asks for feedback, documents decisions) — observed: strong/ok/weak
- Evidence capture template (to paste into candidate file):
   * "Example observed": short quote or paraphrase
   * "Context": which interview/focus area
   * "Confidence (1–5)": numeric
   * "Suggested 14-day goal": small, testable doc or PR assignment

Onboarding checklist (quick actionable items to verify during pulse):
- Access: repo, CI dashboard, tracing/observability consoles, internal docs.
- First PR: small fix with test + changelog entry.
- Platform lab completed: run the deployment harness locally or on dev cluster.
- Runbook edit: one small improvement documented and PR'd.
- Intro syncs: manager, mentor, buddy, cross-team stakeholder.
- Confidence check: pulse survey (3 Qs: access, psychological safety, clarity of next step) completed at day 7 and day 14.

Success metrics for pilot (how we'll judge):
- Time-to-first-merged-PR (target <= 7 days).
- Fraction of hires who complete platform lab by day 14 (> 80%).
- Pulse confidence score (avg >= 4/5 by day 14).
- Hiring rubric alignment: correlation between interview confidence and early performance (small sample).

Operational notes and tooling:
- Use a dedicated "onboard/pilot" label in GitHub to surface learner PRs for triage.
- Add a short structured "evidence" block to interview notes in Lever (or recruiting DB) using the template above.
- Pulse survey as a short Typeform or internal form (3x Likert + one free text).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Mentor bandwidth prevents timely reviews -> Mitigation: schedule protected mentor office hours and a weekly triage slot for onboarding PRs.
- Risk: New hires siloed into busy feature work without platform exposure -> Mitigation: mandatory platform lab completion gated for next sprint allocation.

Open questions / next steps (working list):
- What recruiting fields do we need to add to capture the rubric consistently? (HR ticket linked above).
- Pilot size: recommend 6–8 hires across infra, platform, and serving teams.
- Which mentors volunteer for a 3-month rotation? (ask eng managers to nominate).
- A/B test idea: compare pulse-only vs standard onboarding for time-to-competence.

Appendix: sample hiring-to-onboard handoff note (copy-paste friendly):
- Candidate: <name>
- Obs: strong debugging throughput; moderate system design tradeoff clarity.
- 14-day starter: fix bug #1234, add test, and update runbook section on cache invalidation.
- Mentor match: Elliot R. (prefers trace + perf)

This document is a working draft. Please add comments inline or ping in the linked Slack thread.
